verdicts.explanation: The paper states that the ionic conductivity of Li1/3 Pb1/3 Bi1/3 Te at T = 1.0 (295 K) was calculated to be 6.8 × 10−3 S/cm from its own MD simulations, so the material, value, temperature, and computational origin all match. The 21.85 °C conversion of 295 K is arithmetically correct, and the null secondary fields are appropriate because no synthesis or sintering data apply to this simulation.
